headline: Bahrain Reports Industrial Facility Fire Following Iranian Strike
summary: Bahrain stated an Iranian strike hit a civilian industrial site, sparking a fire. Iran's Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps claimed it targeted U.S. military assets hosting the Fifth Fleet in the kingdom.
why: Bahrain hosts the U.S. Navy's Fifth Fleet and key Persian Gulf industrial infrastructure, vital for international maritime security.

impacts.name: Bahrain
impacts.why: Drone and missile strikes on industrial facilities raise supply chain and security risks in Bahrain.
